About JK Cement

JK Cement Ltd. is one of India’s leading manufacturers of Grey Cement and one of the leading White Cement manufacturers in the World. Over five decades, the Company has partnered with India's multi-sectoral infrastructure needs on the strength of its product excellence, customer orientation, and technology leadership. JKCement commenced operations with the launch of its flagship grey cement unit in Nimbahera, Rajasthan, in May 1975.

As of now, the company has an installed capacity of 32.26 million tons per annum (MnTPA) for grey cement, positioning it among the top cement manufacturers in the country. JKCement is also a leading global manufacturer of white cement, with a total white cement capacity of 1.12 MnTPA in India, and a wall putty capacity of 1.33 MnTPA. JK White Cement products are sold in 36 countries worldwide, and the company has a robust international presence through its subsidiaries, JK Cement Works Fujairah FZC and JK White Cement (Africa) Ltd.

Special Window for Share Transfer and Dematerialization
J.K. Cement Limited informs its shareholders that the
Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), vide Circular dated January 30, 2026,
has introduced a special one-year window for processing physical securities.

1. Key Details:

Window Period February 5, 2026, to February 4, 2027
Scope Re-lodgement of transfer and dematerialization (demat) requests for physical securities
purchased or sold prior to April 1, 2019
Eligibility Requests previously rejected, returned, or left unattended due to documentation
deficiencies, provided they now meet SEBI’s updated requirements

2. Important Mandatory Information

  • Securities will be credited only in dematerialized form.
  • A one-year lock-in applies from the date of transfer registration.
  • No transfer, pledge or lien allowed during lock-in.

3. Action Required

  • Submit documents with RTA (NDML)
  • Update KYC details
  • Convert physical shares into Demat form

For detailed guidelines, refer the </strong >Official SEBI Circular Here</a >
